name: @pipeworx/mcp-newsapi

tools.name: top_headlines
tools.description: Fetch current top news headlines from NewsAPI, filterable by `country` (ISO 2-letter), `category` (business/entertainment/health/science/sports/technology), publisher `sources`, or keyword `q`. Returns article title, description, source, URL, and published date.

tools.name: everything
tools.description: Search the NewsAPI article archive by keyword `q`, source domains, date range (`from`/`to`), or language. Sortable by relevancy, popularity, or publishedAt. Returns article title, description, source, content snippet, URL, and published date.

tools.name: sources
tools.description: Return available NewsAPI publisher sources, filterable by `category`, `language`, and `country`. Returns source id, name, description, URL, and category — use source ids to filter `top_headlines` or `everything`.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-newsapi forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the newsapi pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
